area_contracts.title: Product API
area_contracts.summary: Own local profile input, durable discovery/operation routes, job reads and explicit mock application preparation/run/status. FastAPI/Pydantic interfaces are in OpenAPI at /docs. Requirements: MJ-REQ-181 and initial spine cross-area integration. No career fact inference, workflow truth in UI, or external submission switch. Personal operation rejects fictional discovery, preparation and mock-run before queueing; `/settings` reports the active mode. Public source collection remains available. Queued fixture work is also blocked by workers after a mode switch. Production startup refuses PERSONAL mode if the database contains mock routes. `POST /jobs/manual` persists explicitly entered job text and links through the canonical job, posting snapshot, application route and audit records. It never fetches the supplied URLs; retries require the same request key and content, while a new key creates a distinct record. `GET/PUT /profiles/{profile_id}/ai-task-settings` reads and persists non-secret provider/model choices per profile. Invalid selections fail closed without echoing submitted credentials or malformed values. `GET/PUT /profiles/{profile_id}/ai-cost-policy` persists bounded per-profile funnel thresholds. `GET /profiles/{profile_id}/ai-cost-plan` is a read-only preview over stored deterministic match scores; it makes no provider request and never creates documents. Validation errors omit submitted values. `POST /profiles/{profile_id}/ai-cost-plan/evaluate` requires the configured job-scoring provider and runs only after an explicit request. Validated advisory results, the applied cost policy, and non-secret provider/model identifiers are durably stored against the profile version used; profile changes during inference reject persistence. `GET /profiles/{profile_id}/ai-cost-plan/evaluations` returns bounded recent history for that profile. Neither route changes match scores or creates documents. `POST /profiles/{profile_id}/ai-cost-plan/evaluations/{run_id}/review-documents` persists explicit candidate review up to the run's saved document cap, rejects cross-profile and stale-profile decisions, and exposes the review in history. `POST /applications` can carry that evaluation run ID; the API refuses the AI-funnel preparation path unless the same profile explicitly reviewed that job. The existing preparation flow remains a second deliberate user action. Depends on domain/services/persistence; browser work belongs in workers. Contact and facts are bounded and strict; cross-origin mutations are rejected; default deployment publishes only localhost. Test: python -m unittest tests.integration.test_api_queue. Full user authentication, authorization, dashboard/API coverage and production exposure remain unimplemented.

area_contracts.title: Connected local web application
area_contracts.summary: Owns the React/TypeScript user journey. Same-origin API is the authority; no submission decision is made by client state. Career facts require explicit verification and approval. Demo data is visibly fictional and opt-in. Builds are served by FastAPI; no frontend development server is required for testing. The Jobs view exposes explicit manual capture with an exact description, saved reference/application links, preserved extra source fields and a visible no-fetch explanation. Captured jobs use the existing canonical detail and document-preparation path; their user-entered source identity is unverified. AI Settings exposes independent provider/model selections for each AI task, loads and saves them through the profile-scoped API, and keeps all tasks disabled until the user explicitly saves a local provider choice. AI cost controls persist per-profile score thresholds and bounded work caps; the read-only funnel preview reports eligible/capped counts without invoking a model or creating documents. Controls remain unavailable until saved policy values for the selected profile load successfully. Evaluation remains an explicit action. Validated advisory results are shown in profile-scoped history after reload; they do not change deterministic scores or create documents.

area_contracts.title: Local command ownership
area_contracts.summary: The `cli` package owns project-scoped startup probes, safe fixture verification, workspace identity inspection, and offline local backup/restore commands. It does not own the API's durable state or authorization decisions. The backup interface is `python -m cli.local_backup {backup,verify,restore}`; restore only creates a fresh Compose project and never overwrites existing volumes.

area_contracts.title: Fictional source/company/ATS environment
area_contracts.summary: Own local HTTP fixture contract for MJ-REQ-209 through 213. Data describes Alex Fixture and Example Systems Inc.; it is never user career data or production discovery output. Interface: create_mock_app and fixture_server. Provider endpoints are exposed only inside the private Compose network. Receipts have deterministic application identity and durable mock storage. Tests exercise browser/HTTP/data behavior; acceptance status is recorded separately in the canonical matrix.

area_contracts.title: Domain safety
area_contracts.summary: Own deterministic cross-area contracts and submission decisions (MJ-REQ-000). No network, browser, database, AI, or host configuration side effects belong here.

area_contracts.title: Durable authority
area_contracts.summary: Own relational profiles/fact versions, companies/sources, jobs/postings/routes, matches/documents, applications/attempts, operations and audits. Interfaces: Store(url), save_profile, profile(version), ai_task_settings, save_ai_task_settings, ai_cost_policy, save_ai_cost_policy, jobs, application, transition. Requirements: MJ-REQ-015, 041, 052, 092, 094, 145, 146, 156, 158, 159, 162. SQLAlchemy ORM profile read models share the existing Tables with Core transactional writes. Short-lived read Sessions preserve caller-owned locks, snapshots and transactions; returned values are detached copies. PostgreSQL deployment uses separate least-privileged runtime credentials; explicit SQLite URLs are for tests. Migrations live in migrations/versions and must retain immutable schema history. UI and provider services cannot become durable state authority. Test: .venv/Scripts/python -m unittest discover -s tests. Credentials and personal artifacts are never logged or committed. Counters and submission reservations serialize by profile row.

area_contracts.title: Local agent tool boundary
area_contracts.summary: Owns the typed tool catalog, proposal-only side-effect gate, value-free durable run traces, and least-data prompt projection for MJ-REF-013/014. It does not own model/provider calls, browser sessions, database connections exposed to a model, or external application submission.

area_contracts.title: AI Services Area
area_contracts.summary: Owns provider-neutral AI contracts and explicitly configured model integrations for MJobs.

area_contracts.title: AI Provider Implementations
area_contracts.summary: Provider implementations live behind the provider-neutral contract in `services/ai/providers/__init__.py`.

area_contracts.title: Mock application adapter
area_contracts.summary: Own the explicit local mock ATS headless two-page flow, upload integrity, validation, intervention stop, dry-run and receipt-confirmed mock submission. Interface: apply_mock(store, application_id, mock_origin, output_dir, submit=False). Requirements: MJ-REQ-121, 124, 139, 145, 146, 148, 158, 208, 213. Depend on domain policy, persistence and Playwright. One worker/browser at a time. All HTTP/browser requests are restricted to configured mock origin. No real ATS submission is implemented or enabled. Persist SUBMITTING before click; failed receipt lookup yields SUBMISSION_UNCONFIRMED and never a blind retry. Persistent browser sessions reside only in private output storage. Test: python -m unittest tests.browser.test_mock_application.

area_contracts.title: ATS Detection Area
area_contracts.summary: Owns provider identification from public career-page evidence. Detection does not imply job enumeration, authentication, or application automation support.

area_contracts.title: Career profile extraction
area_contracts.summary: This area implements the native, local-first base-resume import boundary for MJ-REQ-090, MJ-REQ-091, and MJ-REQ-092. PDF, DOCX, and UTF-8 TXT input is parsed without network or AI calls. Results remain `READY_FOR_REVIEW` until a user approves individual facts; empty image-only PDFs use bounded local OCR in the Linux Docker runtime. If OCR is unavailable or unsuccessful they report `NEEDS_OCR`; blank/unreadable documents report `UNREADABLE`. Native text remains reviewable even when OCR fails.

area_contracts.title: Company Discovery Area
area_contracts.summary: Owns company identity resolution, trigger policy, official career-source discovery, automatic source enrollment, and immediate employer enumeration.

area_contracts.title: AREA — services/dedupe
area_contracts.summary: Owns deterministic duplicate-candidate evidence and later merge/review policy.

area_contracts.title: Discovery services
area_contracts.summary: Own the normalized discovery boundary for controlled fixtures and registered public sources. The source contract declares collection strategy and exact capabilities; provider-specific request behavior stays inside adapters.

area_contracts.title: First-party job-source adapters
area_contracts.summary: Own provider collection, parsing, capabilities and bounded public GET requests. Greenhouse currently supports explicitly configured employer boards; global search and application submission are not supported. Requirements: MJ-REQ-016, 018-020, 063.D01, 066-068 and 228 (scoped evidence only).

area_contracts.title: Factual documents
area_contracts.summary: Own verified-fact DOCX/PDF/TXT preparation and version/provenance/hash records. Also own profile-scoped base-resume storage. PDF, DOCX and UTF-8 TXT uploads are bounded to 10 MiB, validated before storage, marked STORED_UNREVIEWED, and checksum-checked on download. Uploads never create or approve CareerFacts. Private originals live in the document volume's uploads directory, so the offline database/document backup must preserve metadata and bytes together. Interface: prepare(store, job_id, profile_id, output_dir) -> application_id. Requirements: MJ-REQ-092 through 099; MJ095 remains partial. Depend on domain safety/persistence, python-docx/reportlab. Default preparation is deterministic. Explicit AI wording proposals require user review and immutable fact references; never invent qualifications. Private files reside under ignored outputs or the document volume, scoped to application and immutable profile version. Test: python -m unittest tests.integration.test_spine tests.integration.test_resume_upload. Named base resumes retain immutable version entries in resume_revisions; repeated uploads within a series are idempotent and version allocation locks the profile. Repeated content keeps the first authoritative filename, media type, format, and stored path even when a later request uses a different matching extension. Native extraction and review belong to services/career_profile. Tailored resume generation now also emphasizes a responsibility bullet only when that approved fact contains an exact matched target-job skill. New tailored and selected-fact revisions use distinct immutable template/model identifiers; older revisions retain their prior skill-only meaning. Exact wording remains unchanged and the match is validated in history/comparison. Broader summary adjustment, factual rephrasing, advanced chronology and document regeneration remain incomplete. Bounded local scanned-PDF OCR and its review gates are owned by career_profile.

area_contracts.title: AREA — services/normalization
area_contracts.summary: Owns deterministic canonical-job presentation and normalization boundaries.

area_contracts.title: Control-plane verification
area_contracts.summary: Own catalogue completeness, dependency consistency and executed evidence tooling. Requirements: MJ-REQ-007, MJ-REQ-008, MJ-REQ-281, MJ-REQ-290 through MJ-REQ-300. Public interface: validate_catalogue(root: Path) -> list[str]; module CLI exits nonzero on inconsistency. No GitHub mutations or product/personal data access. Dependencies: Python standard library. Tests: python -m unittest discover -s tests. New validators must test observable invalid inputs, not exact source text.

area_contracts.title: Durable dispatch and execution
area_contracts.summary: Own deterministic PostgreSQL outbox -> Redis/RQ dispatch and one application worker. Interfaces: enqueue_operation, dispatch_pending, execute_operation. Requirements: MJ-REQ-004, 156, 158, 159 (scoped operation-boundary and initial queue/restart slices). Queue disconnect leaves QUEUED authority in the database. Execution claims use conditional updates; duplicate jobs cannot both claim the same operation. Exhausted and terminal worker failures are durable DEAD_LETTERED rows with attempt timestamps and append-only audit events. Operators may explicitly retry the same operation identity or discard it without erasing its failure record. Submission-ambiguous applications remain in reconciliation and cannot be retried from the dead-letter queue. Redis and worker configuration are private environment values, never job args containing credentials. Error persistence is category only. Tests: integration API/queue tests plus Compose mock E2E. Broader running-operation recovery and manual intervention resume remain PARTIAL; do not requeue a SUBMITTING application for blind retry.
